[[2018–19 UAE Pro League|2018–19]] | nextseason = [[2021–22 UAE Pro League|2021–22]] | updated = 15 May 2021 }} The 2020–21 '''UAE Pro League''' was the 46th edition of the UAE Pro League following the cancellation of the previous season, no team changes occurred due to the previous season declared as void in UAE football.{{cite web|url=https://wam.ae/en/details/1395302851297|title=New UAE football season to kick off September 3: UAE Pro League|publisher=ENA|access-date=26 June 2020}} Despite starting the season with rough results, [[Al Jazira Club|Al Jazira]] went on to win their third league title while [[Baniyas Club|Baniyas]] finished second, coincidentally, both teams finished in the same positions ten years ago in the [[2010–11 UAE Pro League|2010–11 season]]. ==Stadia and locations==
